params.prompt:
Commercial-quality modern pixel-art life simulation set in a fictional contemporary Korean city.

2.5D three-quarter elevated top-down game perspective, consistent game camera, believable architectural depth, layered foreground and background, clearly walkable gameplay space, crisp deliberate pixel edges, consistent pixel density, grounded human proportions and dense environmental storytelling.

The world should feel ordinary, contemporary and lived-in, with understated black comedy about work, money, debt, education, social pressure, consumption and adulthood.

Muted everyday urban colors, restrained saturation, warm practical interior lighting, controlled neon at night, realistic clutter, readable entrances and paths.

Original game art direction. Not based on or copying any existing game.

Not voxel.
Not Minecraft-like.
Not block-based.
Not photorealistic.
Not glossy mobile fantasy.
Not generic anime gacha background.
Not cyberpunk unless explicitly requested.
No readable AI-generated Korean text.
No real brands or logos.
Leave signs and poster text areas blank for later Unity overlays.

A subtle black-comedy pixel-art prop sheet for a modern life simulation.

Utility bills, tax envelopes, instant noodle cups, convenience-store coffee, energy drink cans, cheap desk chair, overtime meal container, broken umbrella, moving boxes, job application papers, loan document folders and exam preparation books.

Grounded realistic appearance.

Humor through context, not cartoon exaggeration.

Modern dense pixel art with crisp deliberate clustered edges and grounded silhouettes; slate, navy and warm brown city surfaces, subdued dark-clothed residents, restrained amber practical lights and teal traffic accents. Ordinary Korean urban life with quiet irony about work and debt, warm sparse homes contrasting with active streets. Consistent elevated three-quarter top-down game perspective, no extreme isometric tilt, clear walkable lanes, readable entrances, layered foreground objects, consistent human scale, blank signboards and no logos.

avoid: voxel art, cubic buildings, low-detail prototype assets, photorealism, glossy 3D render, generic fantasy RPG architecture, excessive bloom, excessive neon, anime mobile game city, distorted perspective, impossible doors and stairs, oversized furniture, tiny doors, inconsistent pixel size, readable fake Korean text, real trademarks, random English logos, excessive visual clutter

Exactly twelve separate complete survival props in a 4 by 3 grid. Preserve all twelve item types in the prompt, one per cell. Paperwork has abstract marks only, absolutely no readable text or numbers. SHEET OUTPUT ONLY: no scene, no panorama, no inset, no surrounding architecture, no labels, no letters or numbers. Solid pure magenta #FF00FF background. Every item fully visible, separated by generous magenta gutters, no overlaps, no shadows crossing cells. Preserve the elevated 2.5D game camera while using a strict flat sheet layout. The attached source sheet guides palette and pixel texture only; do not copy its item count or arrangement. Deliberate square pixel clusters, no soft anti-aliasing, no painterly blur. The result is production design reference, not a finished animation sheet.
